**Links**
- *Preferences > About > Documentation* and the *docs* item in the taskbar menu open the Nilesoft Shell Pro documentation instead of the original Nilesoft Shell docs.
- *Report an issue* opens this project's Discussions, where bug reports go.

**Fixes**
- The Light / Dark switch in the Appearance preview no longer sticks out past the edge of the preview card.

This update only changes the app and a shipped menu file, so an installed copy updates itself without asking for administrator approval.
